##Research Question
How do institutional characteristics (research level, MSI status, college, and department) shape the types of data‑intensive academic programs available to students, and how can these differences inform students’ decisions about program fit?

###R1 vs R2 by programs
```{r}
library(dplyr)

di_prgs_filt_R1R2 %>%
  count(research_level) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  bind_rows(
    summarise(., research_level = "Total", n = sum(n))
  )
```

##Institution breakdown R1 vs R2
```{r}
library(dplyr)

# di_prgs_filt_R1R2 %>%
#   filter(research_level %in% c("R1", "R2")) %>%
#   distinct(institution_name, research_level) %>%
#   count(research_level)

library(dplyr)

counts <- di_prgs_filt_R1R2 %>%
  filter(research_level %in% c("R1", "R2")) %>%
  distinct(institution_name, research_level) %>%
  count(research_level)

counts %>%
  bind_rows(
    tibble(
      research_level = "Total",
      n = sum(counts$n)
    )
  )

```

### Institution Count MSI vs non-MSI
```{r}

library(dplyr)

di_prgs_filt_R1R2 %>%
  filter(research_level %in% c("R1", "R2")) %>%
  distinct(institution_name, MSI_id) %>%
  count(MSI_id)

library(dplyr)

counts <- di_prgs_filt_R1R2 %>%
  filter(research_level %in% c("R1", "R2")) %>%
  distinct(institution_name, MSI_id) %>%
  count(MSI_id)

counts %>%
  add_row(MSI_id = "Total", n = sum(counts$n))

```

# Count by Degree Level

```{r}

  filter(research_level %in% c("R1", "R2")) %>%
  count(research_level, degree_level)
```
```{r}
di_prgs_filt %>%
  filter(research_level %in% c("R1", "R2")) %>%
  count(research_level, department_class) %>%
  arrange(research_level, desc(n))
```

```{r}
di_prgs_filt %>%
  count(MSI_id, department_class) %>%
  arrange(MSI_id, desc(n))
```



```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)


di_prgs_filt %>%
  filter(research_level %in% c("R1", "R2")) %>%   # <-- filter here
  count(research_level, department_class) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = department_class, y = n, fill = research_level)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Department Categories by Research Level (R1 & R2 Only)",
    x = "Department Category",
    y = "Number of Programs",
    fill = "Research Level"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```


```{r}
library(tidyr)

di_prgs_filt %>%
  filter(research_level %in% c("R1", "R2")) %>% 
  count(research_level, department_class) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = department_class,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
install.packages("treemap")
library(treemap)

tree_data <- di_prgs_filt %>%
  filter(research_level %in% c("R1", "R2")) %>%
  count(research_level, department_class, name = "n")

treemap(
  tree_data,
  index = c("research_level", "department_class"),
  vSize = "n",
  title = "Department Breakdown by Research Level",
  palette = "Set3",
  border.col = "white"
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)

sun_data <- di_prgs_filt %>%
  filter(research_level %in% c("R1", "R2")) %>%
  count(research_level, department_class, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    ids     = paste(research_level, department_class, sep = " - "),
    labels  = department_class,
    parents = research_level
  )

plot_ly(
  data = sun_data,
  type = "sunburst",
  ids = ~ids,
  labels = ~labels,
  parents = ~parents,
  values = ~n,
  branchvalues = "total"
)

```
